referee_caveats_inferred: ALMA is used only for two upper limits; how they were derived (aperture, position, primary-beam correction) is not described and they are cited to other papers
Text and tables disagree in places: synthesizer-AGN stars-only chi2_red is 6.9 in the text and 6.5 in the table; CIGALE AGN-fit stellar mass error is 0.2 dex in the text and 0.02 in the table
Best-fit chi2_red values of 5-25 indicate poor fits for all codes, so the stars-versus-AGN preference rests on comparing poor fits
Neither AGN nor starburst is confirmed; no spectroscopy, so the LRD classification relies on photometry and one criterion fails
Absolute photometric depth and flux scale of the ALMA maps are not discussed
